description: Housedata PRISM score: identifies where a property's features (extensions, conversions, floor-area changes) lack a corresponding planning/building-control record, with remediation paths. Requires an active HouseData API key — if the account is not entitled, the error explains how to upgrade.

postcode.description: UK postcode — required if property_id is not given

property_id.description: The property id returned by search_property (an EPC certificate lmk-key). Prefer this over re-supplying a postcode once you have it.
